subtitle: When Bengal’s Lion Reached for the Middle Ganga Throne

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of a royal assembly beside the Ganga, with distant war banners on the horizon
panels.action: Dharmapala stands in regal pose on a riverbank dais near Kanauj, hand resting on his sword, as lesser kings in varied crowns approach cautiously while distant standards of Pratihara and Rashtrakuta armies loom like storm clouds.

dialogue.text: In the age of the Tripartite struggle, Dharmapala of Bengal set a puppet on Kanauj’s throne and claimed northern homage—but rival inscriptions whisper a harsher test of his glory.

i18n.hi: त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष के दौर में बंगाल के धर्मपाल ने कनौज की गद्दी पर कठपुतली बिठाई, उत्तर का सम्मान माँगा — पर दूसरी अभिलेखाएँ उसकी महिमा की सख्त परीक्षा की फुसफुसाहट करती हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in from bird’s-eye over the eastern delta to a medium of a young prince in a riverside palace
panels.action: A younger Dharmapala stands at a balcony of a modest yet dignified palace in Bengal, looking over a misty river dotted with boats and the green expanse of the Ganga delta.

dialogue.text: He was born in the damp mists of eastern Bengal, heir to Gopala’s hard-won throne, in a land where fishermen and feudatories had once torn each other apart under ‘fish-law’—the strong devouring the weak.

i18n.hi: नमी से भरी पूर्वी बंगाल की धुंध में वह पैदा हुआ, गोपाल के कठिन संघर्ष से पाए सिंहासन का वारिस, उस धरती पर जहाँ कभी मछुआरे और सामंत ‘मत्स्यन्याय’ में एक‑दूसरे को नोच खा जाते थे — ताकतवर, कमजोर को चट कर जाता था।

panels.shot: wide shot of battlefield plains near the Ganga with two armies facing off
panels.action: Dharmapala, now older, rides at the head of armoured cavalry on the grassy plains of the middle Ganga, his banner of the Pala emblem held high as infantry ranks stretch behind him toward the horizon.

dialogue.text: Gopala had forged a kingdom from Bengal’s chaos; Dharmapala pushed west, into Bihar and the middle Ganga, where Kanauj—the old capital of emperors—still drew the hunger of every ambitious king.

i18n.hi: गोपाल ने बंगाल की अव्यवस्था से एक राज्य गढ़ा; धर्मपाल पश्चिम की ओर धकेला, बिहार और मध्यम गंगा में, जहाँ कनौज — प्राचीन सम्राटों की राजधानी — हर महत्वाकांक्षी राजा के लालच का केन्द्र बना रहा।

panels.shot: medium shot on Dharmapala in council inside a wooden war pavilion
panels.action: Inside a canvas war pavilion lit by oil lamps, Dharmapala leans over a palm-leaf map spread on a low table, his finger tracing the route from Pundravardhana toward Kanauj as generals listen intently.

dialogue.text: To the west rose the Gurjara-Pratiharas, pressing toward Kanauj; to the south, the Rashtrakutas climbed past the Vindhyas; in the middle, Dharmapala weighed his move, knowing Kanauj could crown or crush his name.

i18n.hi: पश्चिम में गुर्जर‑प्रतिहार उठे, कनौज की ओर बढ़ते; दक्षिण में राष्ट्रकूटों ने विन्ध्य पार चढ़ाई की; बीच में धर्मपाल अपनी चाल तौलता रहा, जानता था कनौज उसके नाम को ताज भी दे सकता है, मटियामेट भी।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-action wide of a clash outside a city gate, kept non-graphic
panels.action: Before city walls with carved gateways, armoured horsemen and foot soldiers collide; Dharmapala is visible on horseback, arm raised to signal advance, while defenders fall back toward Kanauj’s gate, dust rising in the air.

dialogue.text: The Khalimpur copper plate, issued in his thirty-second regnal year, sings that Dharmapala defeated Indrayudha, last of the old Kanauj line, and broke his power on these plains.

i18n.hi: उसके बत्तीसवें राजवर्ष की खलिमपुर ताम्रपट्ट कहती है कि धर्मपाल ने पुराने कनौजवंश के आखिरी राजा इन्द्रायुध को हराया और मैदानों पर उसकी शक्ति तोड़ दी।

panels.shot: solemn interior wide of a throne hall in Kanauj
panels.action: In a newly subdued hall of Kanauj, a simple but symbolic high seat stands at the centre; Dharmapala, in full regalia, guides a more modestly dressed Chakrayudha toward the throne as attendants and guards watch.

dialogue.text: In Indrayudha’s place he set up Chakrayudha, a lesser prince, on Kanauj’s throne—a king who owed his seat not to old lineage, but to the man from Bengal.

i18n.hi: इन्द्रायुध की जगह उसने कनौज की गद्दी पर चक्रायुध नाम के छोटे राजकुमार को बैठाया — ऐसा राजा जिसकी सीट वंश से नहीं, बंगाल से आए इस पुरुष की मेहर से थी।

panels.shot: ceremonial wide shot of a riverside court assembly
panels.action: On a broad terrace by the Ganga, Dharmapala sits on a raised throne under a canopy, while nine envoys or minor kings from different regions stand respectfully below, hands joined in anjali, lush northern landscape behind them.

dialogue.text: The same inscription boasts that nine kings—from the Himalaya foothills to western lands—came to his court, laying their crowns at his feet and receiving his commands by the river’s edge.

i18n.hi: उसी अभिलेख में शेखी है कि नौ राजा — हिमालय की तराई से पश्चिमी इलाकों तक — उसकी दरबार में आए, नदी किनारे उसके चरणों में मुकुट रखकर उसकी आज्ञा लेकर लौटे।

panels.shot: tight medium on Dharmapala receiving a copper plate from a scribe
panels.action: An aged scribe bows as he presents a gleaming copper plate grant; Dharmapala accepts it thoughtfully, the plate’s incised surface catching the light, while courtiers murmur in the background.

dialogue.text: Yet every grand plate was also a poet’s stage. Prasasti praised its patron to the sky; historians later would test these claims, asking how far this homage truly ran beyond Bengal and Bihar.

i18n.hi: पर हर भव्य ताम्रपट्ट कवि का रंगमंच भी होता था। प्रशस्ति अपने पालक की अलौकिक स्तुति करती; बाद के इतिहासकार इन दावों को परखते, पूछते कि बंगाल‑बिहार से परे यह अधीनता सच में कितनी दूर तक गई थी।

panels.shot: montage-like wide showing Dharmapala overseeing monks and artisans at a monastery site
panels.action: Dharmapala stands at the edge of a vast monastery construction site near Nalanda, watching monks in saffron direct artisans carving stone pillars and stupas amid stacks of brick and bamboo scaffolds.

dialogue.text: From his secure base in Bengal and Bihar, he endowed monasteries like Nalanda and built new viharas, tying Buddhist learning to Pala power and using faith as a quiet pillar of his authority.

i18n.hi: बंगाल और बिहार की मजबूत नींव से उसने नालंदा जैसी संस्थाओं को दान दिया और नए विहार बसाए, बौद्ध ज्ञान को पाल सत्ता से जोड़ा और धर्म को अपने अधिकार की शांत आधारशिला बनाया।

panels.shot: dramatic bird’s-eye over India showing three advancing fronts of armies
panels.action: A map-like vista of the subcontinent appears alive with tiny stylised armies: one rising from Bengal, one from western India, one from the Deccan, all converging toward the middle Ganga plain.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars call this the Tripartite struggle, but the land knew not a neat triangle of war—rather a series of clashes as different pairs met in dust and fear on the same contested ground.

i18n.hi: आधुनिक विद्वान इसे ‘त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष’ कहते हैं, पर धरती ने कोई साफ‑सुथरा त्रिकोण नहीं देखा — बस झड़पों की कड़ियाँ, जहाँ अलग‑अलग जोड़ी के राजा वही contested मैदान धूल और खौफ में बाँटते रहे।

panels.shot: low-angle medium of a Rashtrakuta king on campaign in the north
panels.action: A Rashtrakuta king, identifiable by Deccan-style armour and a distinct standard, stands atop a ridge overlooking a northern camp, his officers pointing toward distant flat plains dotted with northern forts.

dialogue.text: From the south, Dhruva of the Rashtrakutas rode north first, and later Govinda III pushed still farther, their own inscriptions claiming victories over northern kings before they turned back to the Deccan.

i18n.hi: दक्षिण से पहले राष्ट्रकूटों के ध्रुव उत्तर बढ़े, फिर गोविन्द तृतीय और आगे चढ़ आया; उनकी अपनी लेखाएँ उत्तर के राजाओं पर विजय का दावा करती हैं, फिर वे लौटकर दक्कन की ओर मुड़े।

panels.shot: somber medium of Dharmapala in a tent hearing news from a messenger
panels.action: Inside a campaign tent lit by a single lamp, Dharmapala sits, jaw set, as a dusty messenger kneels and delivers tidings; a rolled letter bearing a south-Indian seal rests on a low stool.

dialogue.text: The Nesari plates of Govinda III place Dharmapala among those checked or overawed by Rashtrakuta advance, his bold northern reach forced to bend when a stronger wave rose from beyond the Vindhyas.

i18n.hi: गोविन्द तृतीय के नेसरी ताम्रपट्ट धर्मपाल को उन शासकों में रखते हैं जिन्हें राष्ट्रकूट बढ़त ने रोका या डरा दिया, उसकी उत्तर की हिम्मत को झुकना पड़ा जब विन्ध्य पार से और प्रबल लहर उठी।

panels.shot: wide shot of Dharmapala’s forces regrouping closer to Bengal
panels.action: Dharmapala rides along the ranks of his army as they march eastward along the Ganga, Kanauj’s distant skyline fading behind them while the lush, wetter lands of Bihar begin to appear.

dialogue.text: When the Rashtrakutas withdrew south again, the field shifted once more; Dharmapala could return to the middle Ganga, but the throne of Kanauj stayed a seat balanced on other kings’ campaigns as much as his own.

i18n.hi: जब राष्ट्रकूट फिर दक्षिण लौटे, मैदान फिर बदल गया; धर्मपाल दोबारा मध्यम गंगा में आया, पर कनौज की गद्दी उतनी ही उन दूसरे राजाओं की मुहिमों पर टिकी रही, जितनी उसकी अपनी तलवार पर।

panels.shot: intimate medium close-up of Dharmapala in later years in a palace hall lined with manuscripts
panels.action: An older Dharmapala sits cross-legged on a low throne in a hall lined with stacked palm-leaf manuscripts and stone Buddha images, his face lined yet calm, a copper plate and a sword resting beside him.

dialogue.text: By the time his later plates were engraved, his fame ran ahead of his reach; he had not ‘ruled all India’, as later retellings might say, but he had carved an empire in the east and touched Kanauj’s fate.

i18n.hi: जब उसके बाद के ताम्रपट्ट खुदे, उसकी कीर्ति उसकी पहुँच से आगे दौड़ चुकी थी; उसने ‘सारी भारत’ नहीं साधी, जैसा बाद की कहानियाँ कह देंगी, पर पूर्व में एक साम्राज्य गढ़ा और कनौज की किस्मत को छू लिया।

panels.shot: wide shot of Dharmapala supervising artisans carving a donor inscription
panels.action: Dharmapala stands behind artisans etching letters onto a stone slab beside a monastery courtyard; he looks on with a distant expression, as if seeing beyond the stone to the generations that will read it.

dialogue.text: His line of copper plates and stone grants would outlast his campaigns, carrying his version of events—victories, vassals, virtues—down the centuries for scholars to weigh against rival voices in metal and stone.

i18n.hi: उसके ताम्रपट्टों और पत्थर दानों की कड़ी उसके युद्धों से भी आगे चली, उसकी अपनी कथा — विजय, सामंत, सद्गुण — सदियों तक ढोती रही, ताकि विद्वान उन्हें धातु‑पत्थर की प्रतिद्वन्द्वी आवाज़ों से तौल सकें।

panels.shot: timeless interior wide of a modern scholar’s desk lit by a lamp
panels.action: On a wooden desk, under the glow of a modern lamp, lie photographs and rubbings of the Khalimpur plate and Nesari plates, open books by Huntington and Majumdar, and a magnifying glass resting across the page.

dialogue.text: Today, historians place Dharmapala’s claims beside Rashtrakuta records and later research, seeing not a single conqueror of the north, but a powerful Pala king whose reach was real, yet contested and proclaimed with courtly flourish.

i18n.hi: आज इतिहासकार धर्मपाल के दावे राष्ट्रकूट लेखों और बाद की खोज के साथ रखकर देखते हैं — उन्हें कोई अकेला उत्तर विजेता नहीं, बल्कि एक शक्तिशाली पाल राजा मानते हैं जिसकी पहुँच सच भी थी, पर चुनौतीभरी और दरबारी शान से सजाई हुई।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide of Dharmapala’s statue overlooking the Ganga at dusk
panels.action: A weathered stone image of a regal donor, stylised as Dharmapala, stands on a plinth by the river as dusk falls, the Ganga flowing silently past and distant temple silhouettes dark against the sky.

dialogue.text: Dharmapala at Kanauj reminds us that every great claim—whether carved on copper or sung in halls—must stand before many witnesses, and that history’s true power lies in how patiently we listen to them all.

i18n.hi: कनौज में धर्मपाल हमें याद दिलाता है कि हर बड़ा दावा — चाहे ताम्बे पर खुदा हो या सभागृहों में गाया — को कई साक्षियों के सामने टिकना होता है, और इतिहास की असली ताकत इस बात में है कि हम सबकी आवाज़ धैर्य से कैसे सुनते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.en: When Bengal’s Lion Reached for the Middle Ganga Throne
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब बंगाल का शेर पहुँचा मध्यम गंगा के सिंहासन तक
